decisions.reason: This pegboard-backed cardboard display still fits the firm's core capabilities and customers, but after several years a specialized variant would be reviewed if its results only match or fall short of aspiration levels.

This quarter-pallet cardboard display is very close to the firm's core offer, so if it has remained in the range this long management would usually see its performance as at least satisfactory relative to internal and peer aspirations.

The eighth-pallet format serves a somewhat narrower use case and could be pruned if sales disappoint, yet it remains a natural extension of the established display family and does not strongly justify withdrawal.

The media-focused quarter-pallet display is the most niche of the remaining products and is more likely to fall below aspiration levels, making redeployment of resources to stronger core offerings and new development the more likely choice.
